reviews.notes: Chronological walkthrough naming all 6 participants (Customer, Checkout Service, Payment Gateway, Fraud Service, Card Network, Bank) and all 10 messages in diagram order, including the risk check and fund verification steps. No invented content.

Starts from the end state (order confirmed) and traces causally backward to the initial submission. Verified all 10 messages are named despite the reverse ordering: order confirmed, payment authorized, authorization code, verify funds/funds available, risk score: low, submit payment details, authorize(amount, card token). All 6 participants appear.

Enumerates components first, then connections per participant. Cross-checked each of the 10 messages appears exactly once attached to the correct participant pair; no duplicated or invented messages. All 6 participants named.
